title: GTA 6 Trailer Challenge

music.license: Royalty-free. Generated for cliphou.se with the ElevenLabs Music API.

feedback: After the first render that works, the model gets a contact sheet of 12 frames from its own video (one every 32 frames, plus frame 375) and may revise. This happens twice. The model judges its own frames; no human comments are added. If a revision fails to render, the last working version is kept.
repairPolicy: Up to three automated repairs in total after an unusable reply, a truncated reply, or a failed compile or render. The model receives only the error. No human edits. Every attempt is charged to the video.
outputPolicy: The reply is the TSX module. If a model wraps it in one Markdown code fence, the fence is removed. The same rule applies to every model.
